display_name: Alibaba Cloud Container Service for Kubernetes

list_clusters.title: List clusters
list_clusters.description: List the ACK clusters in the account, optionally filtered by name, type or region. Start here to find a cluster_id for every other tool.

cluster_spec.description: Filter by edition, e.g. ack.pro.small or ack.standard.

region_id.description: Filter by region ID, e.g. cn-hangzhou.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The clusters and a page_info block.

get_cluster.title: Get a cluster
get_cluster.description: Read one cluster's configuration and state: version, edition, VPC and vSwitches, network plugin, API server endpoints and status.

create_cluster.title: Create a cluster
create_cluster.description: Create an ACK cluster. The body follows the CreateCluster reference: at minimum name, cluster_type (ManagedKubernetes for ACK managed), region_id, kubernetes_version, vpcid and vswitch_ids, plus node pool or worker settings. Billed resources are created; the call returns a task_id to track with get_task.

region_id.description: The region to create the cluster in, e.g. cn-hangzhou.

cluster_spec.description: For managed clusters, the edition: ack.pro.small (Pro) or ack.standard (Basic).

kubernetes_version.description: The Kubernetes version, e.g. 1.31.1-aliyun.1. Omit for the latest.

vpcid.description: The VPC ID to deploy into.

vswitch_ids.description: The vSwitch IDs for the control plane.

pod_vswitch_ids.description: vSwitch IDs for pods when using the Terway network plugin.

container_cidr.description: The pod CIDR when using Flannel, e.g. 172.20.0.0/16.

snat_entry.description: Create a NAT gateway and SNAT rules so nodes reach the internet.

endpoint_public_access.description: Expose the API server on an EIP.

nodepools.description: Node pools to create with the cluster, each as in CreateClusterNodePool.

deletion_protection.description: Block deletion from the console and API.

modify_cluster.title: Modify a cluster
modify_cluster.description: Change a cluster's mutable settings: name, deletion protection, API server public access, maintenance window and more.

deletion_protection.description: Turn deletion protection on or off.

api_server_eip.description: Bind (true) or unbind (false) an EIP for the API server.

api_server_eip_id.description: The EIP to bind when api_server_eip is true.

instance_deletion_protection.description: Protect the cluster's ECS instances from release.

maintenance_window.description: The maintenance window: {enable, maintenance_time, duration, weekly_period}.

delete_cluster.title: Delete a cluster
delete_cluster.description: Delete a cluster. By default the resources ACK created (nodes, SLB, NAT) are released with it; this cannot be undone. Fails while deletion protection is on.

retain_all_resources.description: Keep every resource the cluster created instead of releasing them.

get_cluster_kubeconfig.title: Get a kubeconfig
get_cluster_kubeconfig.description: Return a kubeconfig for the calling RAM identity, so kubectl can reach the cluster. Credentials are scoped to that identity's RBAC permissions.

private_ip_address.description: Return the internal (VPC) endpoint instead of the public one.

temporary_duration_minutes.description: Issue a temporary kubeconfig valid for this many minutes (15-4320).

output.description: The kubeconfig text in config, and its expiration.

list_cluster_resources.title: List cluster resources
list_cluster_resources.description: List the cloud resources a cluster created or uses: ECS instances, SLB, NAT gateway, security groups, RAM roles and more.

get_cluster_logs.title: Get cluster operation logs
get_cluster_logs.description: Read the cluster's operation log: creation, scaling, upgrades and component changes, with their messages.

upgrade_cluster.title: Upgrade a cluster
upgrade_cluster.description: Upgrade the control plane to a newer Kubernetes version. Check list_kubernetes_versions for valid targets; node pools are upgraded separately.

list_kubernetes_versions.title: List Kubernetes versions
list_kubernetes_versions.description: List the Kubernetes versions ACK offers in a region, with their release and expiry dates and supported runtimes.

output.description: The available versions and their metadata.

list_node_pools.title: List node pools
list_node_pools.description: List a cluster's node pools with their scaling settings, instance types and node counts.

get_node_pool.title: Get a node pool
get_node_pool.description: Read one node pool's configuration: scaling group, instance types, images, labels, taints and auto-scaling bounds.

nodepool_id.description: The node pool ID, e.g. np31da1f38c7f04c4f8fa4b2e1e4a6****.

create_node_pool.title: Create a node pool
create_node_pool.description: Add a node pool to a cluster. nodepool_info names it; scaling_group sets vSwitches, instance types, disks and desired size. Creating nodes is billed.

scaling_group.description: Instance settings: vswitch_ids, instance_types, system_disk_category, system_disk_size, desired_size, key_pair or login_password.

kubernetes_config.description: Node labels, taints, runtime and kubelet settings.

management.description: Managed node pool settings: auto repair and auto upgrade.

modify_node_pool.title: Modify a node pool
modify_node_pool.description: Change a node pool's settings: name, scaling group configuration, Kubernetes labels and taints, auto-scaling bounds or management policy.

nodepool_id.description: The node pool ID, e.g. np31da1f38c7f04c4f8fa4b2e1e4a6****.

scaling_group.description: Changed instance settings, e.g. desired_size or instance_types.

kubernetes_config.description: Changed labels, taints or runtime settings.

update_nodes.description: Apply label and taint changes to existing nodes too.

scale_node_pool.title: Scale out a node pool
scale_node_pool.description: Add nodes to a node pool. This only scales out; to remove nodes use remove_node_pool_nodes, or lower desired_size with modify_node_pool.

nodepool_id.description: The node pool ID, e.g. np31da1f38c7f04c4f8fa4b2e1e4a6****.

delete_node_pool.title: Delete a node pool
delete_node_pool.description: Delete a node pool. Its nodes are drained and released unless they are subscription instances; workloads move only if other pools have room.

nodepool_id.description: The node pool ID, e.g. np31da1f38c7f04c4f8fa4b2e1e4a6****.

force.description: Delete even if the pool still has nodes.

list_cluster_nodes.title: List cluster nodes
list_cluster_nodes.description: List a cluster's nodes with their instance IDs, IPs, roles, node pool and state.

nodepool_id.description: Return only this node pool's nodes.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The nodes and a page block.

remove_node_pool_nodes.title: Remove nodes from a node pool
remove_node_pool_nodes.description: Remove nodes from a node pool, optionally draining them first and releasing the ECS instances. Released instances and their local data are gone.

nodepool_id.description: The node pool ID, e.g. np31da1f38c7f04c4f8fa4b2e1e4a6****.

instance_ids.description: The ECS instance IDs of the nodes to remove, as a JSON array string, e.g. ["i-bp1c9d4tsmn6t0zh****"].

drain_node.description: Drain pods off the nodes before removing them.

release_node.description: Release the ECS instances as well.

list_addons.title: List installed components
list_addons.description: List the components (add-ons) installed in a cluster with their current and upgradable versions.

install_addons.title: Install components
install_addons.description: Install components such as ack-node-problem-detector, logtail-ds or arms-prometheus into a cluster.

addons.description: Components to install, each {name, version, config}.

uninstall_addons.title: Uninstall components
uninstall_addons.description: Uninstall components from a cluster. Workloads that depend on them stop working.

get_task.title: Get a task
get_task.description: Read the progress and result of an asynchronous cluster task, such as a creation, scale-out or upgrade, by the task_id an earlier call returned.

output.description: The task's state, stages and any error.

list_events.title: List cluster events
list_events.description: List ACK events: cluster creation, scaling, upgrades and node failures, optionally for one cluster.

type.description: Filter by event type, e.g. cluster_create or nodepool_scaleout.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The events and a page_info block.

get_user_permissions.title: Get a RAM user's cluster permissions
get_user_permissions.description: Read the RBAC permissions a RAM user or role holds on each cluster and namespace.

uid.description: The RAM user or role ID.

grant_permissions.title: Grant cluster permissions
grant_permissions.description: Replace a RAM user or role's RBAC permissions across clusters. The list sent becomes the full set: anything left out is revoked.

uid.description: The RAM user or role ID.

permissions.description: The permission list, each {cluster, namespace, role_name (admin, ops, dev, restricted or a custom ClusterRole), role_type (cluster or namespace), is_custom}.
